And 3(2)(v) Of Sc/St (Poa) Act (Vide Annexure-E).

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Parties present with their respective counsel.
They present a joint memo.
2. On enquiry with the parties, the defacto complainant represented by Sri Vijay S.Chiniwar submits that there is no force, undue influence or coercion in reaching out the terms of settlement.

3. Taking note of the age of the victim lady and also her future, in view of the true settlement, even though the offences alleged against the petitioner are not compoundable, following the dictum of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Ramgopal and another Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 834, matter needs to be put to rest.

entities.text: Ramgopal and another Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 834
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Moreover, this Court is of the considered opinion that pending criminal proceedings would act as hindrance for the future of the defacto complainant.
Further, the dispute is privy to the parties.
4. Taking note of these aspects of the matter, a case is made out for quashing further proceedings pending in Special Case No.49/2022.
Accordingly, following order is passed.
ORDER Keeping the joint memo on record, petition is allowed.
Pending criminal proceedings in Special Case No.49/2022 on the file of II Addl.District and Sessions Judge, Bagalkot are hereby quashed.
